scenarios.title: Sisters' Burial Grounds: Cold Plains, Burial Grounds, kill Blood Raven, report to Kashya (board-driven)
scenarios.provenance: CHEATED: level 16, 8000 gold, the Cold Plains waypoint and potions by SETUP verbs (a played hero reaches Blood Raven at about level 8 to 12). Town start, nothing written after the start. Mechanics only.
scenarios.notes: The tapper taps Start on blood_raven and Hand in when the board waits. Done is record 2 bit 0 (V docs/forkcheats.md: Blood Raven record 2, 0x0002 = reward pending, the Kashya talk makes it 0x0001). The Rogue hire is a separate goal and not asserted. The title 'Bane of Blood Raven' is a kill-count title of the hall table (internal/watch/hall_titles.json) and is checked as data by TestBloodRavenTitleExists, not here: the run has no Hall reader. town.bankFirst 0: with the default the bank chore moved 6900 of the 8000 gold into the stash in the first minute and the chunk then waited 28 minutes on chores it could not pay (run 20261120-184924-bb3e, finding in the probe doc). Belt is four healing potions: the kit gate asked for 'healing potions 3/4' with a 3+1 belt and the chunk sat on its chores step (run 20261120-192148-b1a8).

assert.why: V docs/forkcheats.md: record 2 is Sisters' Burial Grounds, bit 0 = reward taken
no death: these setups are far above the boss's level, a death is a RED (the format has no min 0 with a positive max)
chicken bound: at most 3 chickens (the one 'starting chunk' line is counted in the max)
the board started the tapped chunk (the hero engaged)

scenarios.title: Sisters to the Slaughter: the board holds Andariel back from a naked clvl-26 hero (too hard), the Monastery road is open
scenarios.provenance: CHEATED: level 26 (Normal Andariel is dangerous below about clvl 24), 15000 gold, the waypoints Cold Plains to Catacombs 2, a hired merc (hireling 0) and potions by SETUP verbs. Without the merc the board holds Andariel back as 'too hard' (run 20261120-221758-41b3: no merc, short of potions, would likely lose), which is the readiness model working as intended. Town start, nothing written after the start. Mechanics only, never a statement about the level a played hero fights her at.
scenarios.notes: MILESTONE (andariel1): the board holds Andariel as too hard for this hero (no skills spent, clvl 26 from a SETUP verb): the readiness model is right, the tapper logs the reason, and the hero must still walk the Monastery road to the Outer Cloister. The kill itself (record 6 bit 1) needs a geared hero and is U. The tapper taps Start on andariel (autoStart is never: a player decision). Kill sets record 6 to 0x2002 or similar with bit 1 = reward pending (V docs/d2d-probes.md: 0x200a after the kill; the Warriv talk sets bit 0). The assertion is the kill word (bit 1); the hand-in to Warriv belongs to act1_done.sail_east, not here. town.bankFirst 0: with the default the bank chore moved 6900 of the 8000 gold into the stash in the first minute and the chunk then waited 28 minutes on chores it could not pay (run 20261120-184924-bb3e, finding in the probe doc). Belt is four healing potions: the kit gate asked for 'healing potions 3/4' with a 3+1 belt and the chunk sat on its chores step (run 20261120-192148-b1a8). Level 26, not 30: with goals reach:30 a level-30 hero finishes its goal at once and idles, the board never starts (run 20261120-204236-684a).

assert.why: the road past the Monastery Gate is open: the hero reached the Outer Cloister (run 20261120-230516-0e0d: travel from the Monastery Gate failed with no exit; fix card andariel1: the nav walks to a border d2d cannot read from afar)
no death: the board holds the fight back, a death is a RED
